observation.visible_scene: A brightly lit dance studio with white walls, a light wood floor, a dark ceiling with track spotlights, a wall-mounted air-conditioning unit, a sheer white curtain, and a large floor-to-ceiling mirror wall on the right. A woman with a long dark ponytail, wearing a sleeveless denim top, a dark pleated mini-skirt, and black thigh-high heeled boots, stands in the left-center of the frame with her back partly to the camera, facing the mirror. Her frontal reflection is visible in the mirror. The camera is static: the ceiling lights, mirror seams, AC unit and curtain hold fixed screen positions across all frames.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-8) the woman's right foot is lifted behind her with the knee bent; this lifted leg lowers until both feet are planted by about frame 9, and the reflection shows the same transition.

Her arms move through a continuous sequence: extended forward toward the mirror (frames 1-7), then drawn in with bent elbows and hands gesturing near the chest (frames 9-13), then opened out to the sides (frames 14-18).
She shifts her stance width, from feet together to a wider stance (frames 14-23), then to a crossed/offset ankle position (frames 24-26), and back to a wider stance (frames 27-31).

In the latter half (frames 32-41) she raises one arm bent at the shoulder with the hand near her face while the other arm bends across her chest, holding this pose with small adjustments; the reflection mirrors these arm positions frontally.

Throughout, the mirror reflection reproduces her pose and limb movements as a frontal image rather than a second independent person; the woman's body position in the room stays roughly the same horizontal location while only her limbs and stance change.
